description: Objective prompts for evaluating the justfile skill. Each eval sets up a fresh workspace from `fixture.files`, runs `prompt` against an agent, and checks the result against `expectations`. Run once with the skill unavailable (baseline) and once with `.agents/skills/justfile/SKILL.md` loaded (with-skill); the with-skill run must satisfy every expectation and must not regress any expectation the baseline already met.

evals.description: Create a capitalized Justfile for a small uv Python project that has none yet.
evals.prompt: This is a small uv-managed Python project. Create a capitalized `Justfile` (not lowercase `justfile`) with recipes to install dependencies, run the test suite, and lint the code.

evals.description: Adding a tenth non-default recipe to an existing flat, lowercase justfile must cross the grouping threshold.

files.justfile:
set ignore-comments
set script-interpreter := ['bash', '-eu']
set unstable

[default]
_default:
    @just --list

# Installs dependencies
deps:
    npm install

# Runs the test suite
test:
    npm test

# Lints source files
lint:
    npm run lint

# Formats source files and the justfile
format:
    npm run format
    just --fmt

# Builds the project
build:
    npm run build

# Runs the project locally
run:
    npm start

# Removes build artifacts
clean:
    rm -rf dist node_modules/.cache

# Type-checks the project
typecheck:
    npm run typecheck

# Generates documentation
docs:
    npm run docs

evals.prompt: Add a `deploy` recipe to this justfile that runs `./deploy.sh production`.

evals.description: Editing a *.just file that already has an `install` recipe must surface the install-to-deps rename suggestion during the active edit, without a rename-only, unprompted change.

expectations.note: The agent's reply must mention renaming install to deps as a suggestion; it must not silently rename with no mention, and must not rename in a commit/change with no other purpose.

files.tasks.just:
# Installs project dependencies
install:
    npm install

# Runs the test suite
test:
    npm test

evals.prompt: Add a `clean` recipe to tasks.just that removes the dist/ directory.
